covers.name: BetterWorkbench
covers.prompt: Create ONE square standalone Palworld Steam Workshop cover. Image 1 is this mod's existing cover: preserve its subject identities, feature concept and exact text. Image 2 is approved style and composition reference: match its polished bright colorful 3D game art, strong foreground/midground/background depth, controlled detail, clear focal point and bold white fantasy typography. Regenerate image 1 with the visual restraint of image 2. A few softly out-of-focus blades of grass and small stones at the bottom foreground, sharply readable main subject in middle ground, open blue sky, soft clouds and ONE subdued distant mountain ridge in background. Background low contrast and low detail, never competing with subject. Remove towers, floating cliffs, settlements, banners, fences, excessive foliage and scattered props. Retain a real environment and depth, not a blank studio background. Restrained magical effects and sparks. Small exact 'PALWORLD MOD' upper left. Large white English title in lower third, thin rule with center hollow diamond, white Chinese subtitle underneath, generous safe margins. No extra text, watermark, panels or collage. Main subject wooden crafting workbench with one hammer and warm amber ingot, smiling fluffy Lamball helping at right. Above bench a clear gold circular arrow flow connects a few large wood/ore/ingot icons. Remove lantern, tool containers, back fences and spare tools. Preserve clear gold crafting theme, simplify tabletop. Exact title 'BETTER' / 'WORKBENCH', subtitle '更好的工作台'.
